verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents exporting the cap table or transaction history to Excel or CSV. The reporting claims (docs-4, docs-11, docs-19) cover audit-ready and compliance reports, an adjacent capability rather than a data export. The migration offer (docs-1) is about bringing data in, not getting it out. The probes show only an llms.txt file and no public API spec, so there is no programmatic export path either.
